sessions.title: demo.db + IM_Macro_DB Extraction

smart_config.role: Data Engineer + CNC Tool Database Specialist

sessions.intent: Extract the two largest unprocessed databases: demo.db (547 tools + 2,706 cutting technology entries) and IM_Macro_DB (drilling macros with formulas). demo.db alone contains more cutting technology data than all currently extracted hyperMILL data combined.

units.title: Build demo.db extraction script — 547 tools + 2,706 cutting techs
units.description: Create extract-hypermill-demo-db.py script that reads demo.db (SQLite) and extracts: 547 tool definitions (29 geometry classes from ToolExportEngine schema), 2,706 cutting technology entries (speed, feed, depth per material-tool combination), holder geometry catalog. Output: hypermill-demo-tools.json and hypermill-demo-cutting-tech.json in PRISM-consumable format. Use HyperMillToolExportEngine's SQLite schema (29 geometry classes) as the extraction template.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: extract-hypermill-demo-db.py reads demo.db SQLite successfully
547 tools extracted with all 29 geometry class fields
2,706 cutting tech entries extracted with speed/feed/depth
Output JSON files validate against ToolRegistry schema
cam:hypermill_extract_tools action registered to trigger extraction
3 unit tests: tool extraction count, cutting tech count, geometry class coverage

units.title: Build IM_Macro_DB extraction — drilling macros + formula registration
units.description: Create extract-hypermill-macro-db.py script that reads IM_Macro_DB and extracts: drilling macro definitions (peck depth formulas, pilot hole sizing, countersink angles), feature-to-job macros (omFeature2JobCatalog XMLs). Register discovered formulas in FormulaRegistry as F-HM-EXT-001 through F-HM-EXT-NNN. Agent 20 found 0/14 hyperMILL formulas in FormulaRegistry — this starts filling that gap.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: extract-hypermill-macro-db.py reads IM_Macro_DB successfully
Drilling macro formulas extracted and validated
Feature-to-job macros parsed from XML
Formulas registered in FormulaRegistry as F-HM-EXT series
3 unit tests: macro extraction, formula registration, XML parsing

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ demo.db extracted (547 tools + 2,706 cutting techs) | ✓ IM_Macro_DB extracted | ✓ Formulas registered in FormulaRegistry | ✓ cam:hypermill_extract_tools action active | ✓ tsc 0 errors | ✓ 6+ tests pass | omega_floor >= 0.90 | SVI delta: +2%

sessions.title: AC_Standard_ToolDB + IM_Tool_DB + Metric.cfg Extraction + Data Freshness Hook
sessions.intent: Extract the remaining 3 databases and build the data freshness hook. Metric.cfg directory (138+ files) contains factory defaults that HyperMillCycleDefaultsEngine already reads — but this extraction makes them available to the broader PRISM pipeline.

units.title: Build AC_Standard_ToolDB + IM_Tool_DB extraction scripts
units.description: Create extraction scripts for AC_Standard_ToolDB (standard Automation Center tool database) and IM_Tool_DB v1 (legacy tool database). Both contain tool geometry and holder assembly data that supplements demo.db. Output: hypermill-ac-tools.json and hypermill-im-tools.json. Merge with demo.db data to create unified hypermill-tools-complete.json with deduplication.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: AC_Standard_ToolDB extraction script works
IM_Tool_DB v1 extraction script works
Unified hypermill-tools-complete.json created with deduplication
Holder geometry data extracted (Agent 17: holders=8/100)
3 unit tests: AC extraction, IM extraction, deduplication logic

units.title: Build Metric.cfg directory extraction — 138+ config files → structured defaults
units.description: Create extract-hypermill-metric-cfg.py that reads the entire Metric.cfg directory (138+ configuration files for cycle defaults per controller) and outputs structured JSON. Currently HyperMillCycleDefaultsEngine reads these files at runtime — this extraction creates a static snapshot for offline use and cross-referencing. Output: hypermill-cycle-defaults-complete.json with per-controller, per-cycle-type parameter defaults.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP

3 unit tests: file count, parameter type preservation, runtime match

units.title: Build hypermill-data-freshness hook + extraction orchestrator
units.description: Build hypermill-data-freshness hook that checks extraction timestamps and warns if any extracted data is > 30 days old (hyperMILL installations may be updated). Build HyperMillDataExtractionOrchestrator that runs all 5 extraction scripts in sequence, validates outputs, and reports extraction status (counts, freshness, errors).
